text: Implemented in Python using only the standard library (no third-party imports)
Create a post (POST) returning the created post
Read posts: list all posts and get a single post by id; 404 for missing
Update a post (PUT/PATCH) by id; 404 for missing
Delete a post by id; 404 for missing
X-API-Key header authentication: requests without/with wrong key are rejected (401/403)
Requests with valid X-API-Key are accepted
JSON request bodies parsed; invalid JSON yields 400
JSON response bodies with application/json content type
Input validation of post fields (missing/wrong-typed required fields -> 400)
Delivered as a single file blog_api.py
Unknown routes return 404 JSON error, server does not crash on bad input
